_help: World map window in 1366x768 space. World map: wx,wy,ww,wh is the window; worldX/worldY the map art inside it; titleH is the title strip height; infoX/infoY the region title in MAP INFO; listX/listY the map list under it; listW the text width (a long name wraps); listStep the row pitch; listH the height of the list area (the rows that fit); wheelStep the lines one wheel notch scrolls; scrollX is the official scroll bar beside the list (the track and the thumb art are 5 px wide, so the width comes from the art; the thumb art is 5x26 and is drawn at that size; the bar spans the rows, so it uses listY and listH). wcloseX/wcloseY the X button. The region dots: dotW/dotH is the drawn dot; dotClickW/dotClickH is the click box on a dot (it sits on the dot). goX/goY/goW/goH = the Go button under the list (it travels to the picked map). The minimap window has its own file (panel-minimap.json).
